# AGENTS.md — Build, Test, and Validation Commands
# Auto-generated by spec-to-ralphprep | Project: onboarding-real-connect-redesign
# Ralph writes its code into the ap-hub repo root (C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\ap-hub);
# this ralph-onboarding-connect/ directory holds only ralph's own state/specs, not app code.

## Environment

No new required env vars — reuses existing GMAIL_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, QBO_SANDBOX_CLIENT_ID/SECRET,
SESSION_COOKIE_SECRET, WEB_BASE_URL. CHUNK_3 changes two DEFAULTS (PORT, redirect URIs) — if
`.env` sets these explicitly, update it to the new port (3001) too.
`export DATABASE_URL=postgres://aphub:aphub@127.0.0.1:5432/aphub` must be set before the gate.

## Install

```bash
npm install
```

## Database

```bash
npm run migrate:up    # idempotent; expect "No pending migrations" (this feature adds none)
```

## Development Server

```bash
npm run dev            # pipeline + OAuth callbacks + pg-boss workers, now :3001 after CHUNK_3
npm run web:dev         # Next.js App Router UX, :3000 — /onboarding is where this feature lives
```

## Test

```bash
npm test              # unit + DB-backed (src/** + test/**)
```

## Lint / Type Check

```bash
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
```

## Build (production, covers app/)

```bash
npm run web:build
```

## Validation Commands

```bash
npm run migrate:up && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run web:build
```
